name: focusly
description: Focusly — app hospedado, dados no backup local

scripts.serve:dist: npm run build && npx --yes serve dist -l 3847
scripts.deploy:netlify: npm run build && npx --yes netlify-cli deploy --prod --dir=dist
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build && npx --yes firebase-tools deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name focusly
